野战学院综合项目 / Field Academy

训练厂生产侦察车和双炮战车，附带可合入地图的增援触发片段
A factory, a recon vehicle and a twin-turret tank, with a reinforcement trigger fragment

使用方式 / Getting started
1 导入 .rwmod，启用后重新加载 / Import the .rwmod, enable it and reload
2 在沙盒搜索 rwa06 或单位英文名称 / Search the sandbox for rwa06 or the English unit name
3 按下方步骤逐项观察 / Follow the checks below

1 从沙盒创建训练厂，分别生产两种车辆
   Create the factory in the sandbox and produce both vehicle types
2 让双炮战车攻击一个地面目标，观察两侧炮口
   Attack a ground target with the twin tank and observe both guns
3 在地图副本中合并 XML 片段并启用此模组，确认队伍 0 存在
   Merge the XML fragment into a map copy, enable this mod and confirm team 0 exists
4 运行地图，观察 10 秒后的消息和三辆增援
   Run the map and observe the message and three reinforcements after 10 seconds

验证说明 / Verification
字段与引用按 Rusted Warfare 1.15 参考目录检查，尚未在游戏引擎中运行
Fields and references are checked against the Rusted Warfare 1.15 reference catalog, in-game behavior has not been tested

素材与许可 / Assets and license
本项目代码、文档与小尺寸像素图片为原创教学内容，以 CC0-1.0 提供
Original tutorial code, documentation and small pixel sprites are provided under CC0-1.0

地图片段 / Map fragments
若包含 XML，它只作为现有有效地图的对象片段使用，不是独立 TMX 地图
Any included XML is a fragment for an existing valid map, not a standalone TMX map
